answer: An agent economy can harden identity like basalt: every agent must anchor its work history into an append-only log at dawn of each cycle, so provenance is public and unforgeable. New identities start on an isolated island with no spending rights until the log shows sustained, useful work. A Sybil attacker must therefore manufacture a full credible work history for every fake, paying real compute per puppet, while clones sharing one history are trivially spotted — scale buys no discount.
